figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: one equation a = -ω²x played out across springs, pendulums, energy and resonance
figures.read: every result is ω=√(k/m), an energy share, or a resonance peak

figures.title: The phase ladder: v leads x, a leads v
figures.why: the three sinusoids differ only by quarter-turns
figures.data: x=A sin ωt; v leads by 90°; a opposite to x
figures.read: velocity a quarter-cycle ahead of displacement; acceleration points back at equilibrium

figures.title: Energy exchange: all kinetic in the middle, all potential at the ends
figures.why: the two shares trade without changing the total
figures.read: the box holds a fixed total poured between spring and motion

figures.title: Springs: parallel adds, series reciprocates
figures.why: the only work is finding k_eff before the period formula
figures.read: parallel is the recipe for stiffer, series for softer

figures.title: Resonance: small damping, tall sharp peak
figures.why: every forced-oscillator question is about the peak's height and width
figures.data: peak near ω=ω0; Q=ω0/2γ sets height and width
figures.read: light damping makes a needle-sharp spike; heavy damping flattens it

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: period wants system constants, initial conditions want the phase, speed wants energy
